title: indices.get_data_stream_mappings
description:
Get data stream mappings.

Get mapping information for one or more data streams.

master_timeout.description:
The period to wait for a connection to the master node. If no response is
received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an
error.

name.description: A comma-separated list of data streams or data stream patterns. Supports wildcards (`*`).

error_trace.description:
When set to `true` Elasticsearch will include the full stack trace of errors
when they occur.

filter_path.description:
Comma-separated list of filters in dot notation which reduce the response
returned by Elasticsearch.

human.description:
When set to `true` will return statistics in a format suitable for humans.
For example `"exists_time": "1h"` for humans and
`"exists_time_in_millis": 3600000` for computers. When disabled the human
readable values will be omitted. This makes sense for responses being consumed
only by machines.

pretty.description:
If set to `true` the returned JSON will be "pretty-formatted". Only use
this option for debugging only.
